application_semantics: Group by source_path and original source_sha256. Verify the original once, preflight every before count, apply all non-overlapping literal replacements to one in-memory copy in listed order. Never re-check original SHA against an intermediate modified copy; never write the archive. A future adopter saves a separately versioned derivative only.
